nodes.natural_language: Define the sequence by x1=211, x2=375, x3=420, x4=523 and xn=xn-1-xn-2+xn-3-xn-4 for n>=5.
nodes.statement: sequence defined by given initials and linear recurrence of order 4

nodes.natural_language: The linear recurrence implies that the generating sequence of consecutive 4-tuples is completely determined by the initial 4-tuple, so it suffices to compute the first several terms until the initial 4-tuple reappears.
nodes.statement: future evolution and periodicity determined by 4-tuple state repetition

nodes.natural_language: Direct computation of the first 12 terms yields x11=x1 and x12=x2, and by the recurrence the sequence is therefore periodic with period 10.
For any positive integer k, x_{10k+r}=x_r when 1<=r<=10.
Direct computation yields x_5=267, x_6=-211, x_7=-375, x_8=-420, x_9=-523, x_10=-267 and x_11=211=x_1, hence the sequence is purely periodic of period 10.
nodes.statement: sequence is purely periodic with period 10

nodes.natural_language: Reducing the given indices therefore yields 531≡1, 753≡3 and 975≡5 mod 10, so x_531 + x_753 + x_975 = x_1 + x_3 + x_5 =211+420+267=898.
Since the sequence is purely periodic of period 10, we have x_n = x_{n mod 10} (with the representative in {1,...,10}) for every n >=1.
nodes.statement: reduction of index via pure period 10

nodes.natural_language: Computing successive terms of the recurrence produces the 4-tuple (x_{11},x_{12},x_{13},x_{14})=(211,375,420,523), which coincides with the initial 4-tuple, so the sequence of 4-tuples (and hence the sequence itself) is periodic of period 10.
Consequently every term depends only on its index modulo 10, and the required sum may be evaluated by reducing the three indices 531, 753 and 975 modulo 10.
nodes.statement: terms depend only on index mod 10; sum obtained by reducing indices mod 10

nodes.natural_language: The residues of the three indices modulo 10 are uniquely determined by the last digits of those indices, confirming 531≡1, 753≡3 and 975≡5.
nodes.statement: last digits determine residues mod 10 confirming given congruences

nodes.natural_language: Because the characteristic polynomial of the recurrence divides t^{10}-1, every term of the sequence is completely determined by its residue class modulo 10.
nodes.statement: char poly divides t^10-1 implies terms depend only on index mod 10
